title: French family benefits: per-child entitlement PrestationsFamiliales.droit_ouvert (Code de la sécurité sociale L512-3, R512-2, L821-3) at 2020-05-01

attributes.name: residence
attributes.source: PrestationsFamiliales input résidence (prologue.catala_fr:53), type France.Collectivité (prologue_france/France.catala_fr:9-18); labels are the ASCII constructor names of the generated Python, representatives the Catala constructors

attributes.name: obligation_scolaire
attributes.source: Enfant.obligation_scolaire (prologue.catala_fr:24), type SituationObligationScolaire (prologue.catala_fr:17-20); read by L512-3 1° and 2° (securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:54-71)

attributes.name: prise_en_charge
attributes.source: Enfant.prise_en_charge (prologue.catala_fr:27), type PriseEnCharge (prologue.catala_fr:10-15); not read by droit_ouvert (included as required by the protocol; see CONVERSION.md C4)

attributes.name: age

a03_16.predicate: date_de_naissance + 3 an < date_courante and date_de_naissance + 16 an >= date_courante

a16_20.predicate: date_de_naissance + 16 an < date_courante and date_de_naissance + 20 an > date_courante

attributes.source: Enfant.date_de_naissance (prologue.catala_fr:26); representative = date_de_naissance at date_courante 2020-05-01. Threshold 20 an: L512-3 2° comparison date_de_naissance + âge_l512_3_2 > date_courante (securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:71) with âge_l512_3_2 = 20 an (R512-2, securite_sociale_R.catala_fr:21). Thresholds 3 an and 16 an: Code de l'éducation L131-1 as encoded in epilogue.catala_fr:121-131 (used only by exclusions X1-X3)

attributes.name: remuneration
attributes.source: Enfant.rémuneration_mensuelle (prologue.catala_fr:25), in euros per month. Ceiling plafond_l512_3_2 = (smic.brut_horaire * 55%) * 169,0 (R512-2, securite_sociale_R.catala_fr:30-31; R755-0-2, securite_sociale_R.catala_fr:219-223), compared with <= in L512-3 2° (securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:70). SMIC at 2020-05-01: 10,15 € / Mayotte 7,66 € (smic/Smic.catala_fr:80-110). With the runtime's rounding to the cent after each product the ceiling is 943,02 € (Mayotte 711,49 €); eq_plafond's representative depends on residence (see representative_by_residence and CONVERSION.md C6)

exclusions.description: obligation_scolaire Avant with a child whose third birthday has passed: Avant means date_de_naissance + 3 an >= date_courante
exclusions.source: Code de l'éducation L131-1 (instruction obligatoire dès l'âge de trois ans), as the same encoding derives obligation_scolaire in InterfaceAllocationsFamiliales, epilogue.catala_fr:104-131 (lines 123-124)

exclusions.description: obligation_scolaire Pendant with a child outside the compulsory-schooling ages: Pendant means date_de_naissance + 3 an < date_courante <= date_de_naissance + 16 an
exclusions.source: Code de l'éducation L131-1 (de trois à seize ans), epilogue.catala_fr:121-131 (lines 123-128)

exclusions.description: obligation_scolaire Apres with a child who has not passed the sixteenth birthday: Apres means date_de_naissance + 16 an < date_courante
exclusions.source: Code de l'éducation L131-1 (jusqu'à l'âge de seize ans), epilogue.catala_fr:121-131 (lines 127-129)

date_courante.why: the date of the official test tests_ouverture_droits.catala_fr Test1 (and of most AF tests); SMIC 2020 applies (Smic.catala_fr:80-110)

a_deja_ouvert_droit_aux_allocations_fami.why: not read by droit_ouvert; vrai as in every official test child

notes: Output is droit_ouvert. conditions_hors_âge is left out because its disjunction over the three obligation_scolaire values is always true, so it reduces to the earnings test alone (securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:76-84). The scope PrestationsFamiliales takes obligation_scolaire as an input independent of the date of birth; exclusions X1-X3 restore the link the epilogue uses. See CONVERSION.md.
